initial_rule: fresh p1 anchor [0.3,1] -> repeat beta/gamma for p2
primary_metric: exact endpoint P_opt; P_valid separately; no postselection/bit repair
comparison: exact only; fresh mean p1:100 + INTERP p2:100 per objective; total cap200; no seed repetitions
scope: one fixed previously observed reference; objective study after choosing INTERP on this reference; exploratory, no matched-time/generalization claims
historical_note: no trained angles/results imported from Notebook23; alpha1 is a fresh control
interp_rule: Zhou et al. PRX 10 021067 (2020), Appendix B Eq B1; p1 -> p2 repeats beta and gamma
winner_rule: COBYLA returned point under that stage objective; never select using P_opt
